purpose: Security refinement from SYSPRO's own OData service documentation: read-only SQL access is available, but the OData service bypasses normal SYSPRO security controls such as branch access. This is therefore an explicit evidence blocker until effective company/table scope is proven or a customer-controlled constrained projection is used.

securityEvidenceBlockers: SYSPRO documents that the OData Service bypasses the normal SYSPRO security framework, including controls such as branch access. Although generated OData SQL credentials are read-only, read-only is not sufficient evidence of least privilege. Before sandbox/tenant authentication can count as WFM evidence, prove that the effective SQL/OData identity is restricted to the approved companies and tables, or terminate it behind a customer-controlled constrained read projection.
patch.evidenceNote: SYSPRO documentation verifies an OData 4.0 service that provides RESTful read-only data access for third-party applications, available to on-premise and SYSPRO Cloud ERP; cloud customers must use OData because direct database access is unavailable. OData uses Basic authentication over HTTPS and generated SQL users can be read-only. A material security caveat is also vendor-documented: the OData Service bypasses SYSPRO's normal security framework, including controls such as branch access. WFM therefore keeps the connector spec-verified only, fails closed to customer edge for deployment ambiguity, and blocks authenticated evidence until effective company/table scope is demonstrated or a customer-controlled constrained read projection is used. e.net/business-object writes, SQL writes and MOM outbound transactions remain outside WFM authority.
